subject.title: feat(plugins): mirror local coding sessions to a remote Beam receiver

question: Should the bundled Beam plugin receive the new private local-only session-catalog read facade as the supported boundary for continuously mirroring local coding sessions?
rationale: The branch introduces both a new persistent plugin configuration surface and a new SDK subpath that grants plugins access to local transcript content; code review can assess its narrowness, but maintainers must choose whether this is the intended durable product and ownership boundary.

options.title: Approve the narrow Beam boundary
options.body: Accept the read-only local catalog facade for Beam after exact-head proof confirms redaction, receiver authentication, and completed-session updates.

options.title: Keep mirroring plugin-local
options.body: Require a Beam-specific injected runtime seam instead of adding a reusable SDK subpath if generalized plugin access to local catalogs is not desired.

options.title: Defer the sender capability
options.body: Pause the PR until maintainers define a broader consent, endpoint, or distribution policy for live session mirroring.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow Beam boundary
recommendation.body: Accept the read-only local catalog facade for Beam after exact-head proof confirms redaction, receiver authentication, and completed-session updates.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged Beam receiver history and this follow-up identify steipete as the strongest available owner for the Beam distribution and trust-boundary decision.
